headline: Congress approved reappointing Risa Lavizzo-Mourey as a citizen regent of the Smithsonian Institution's governing board.
what_it_does: This joint resolution renews the term of Risa Lavizzo-Mourey as a citizen regent on the Board of Regents of the Smithsonian Institution. The Smithsonian is a federal museum and research group, and its board oversees it. The resolution is a personnel action and does not change any rules or spending for the public.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on March 2, 2020, when it became Public Law 116-119.
